## Why visit

A convenient way to explore Black Lodge beer during a Wirral day if the Liverpool brewery’s limited opening does not fit the trip. The town-centre bar serves cask and keg, and the upstairs room is used for tastings and events. It is most useful as an additional specialist stop after the nearby West Kirby Tap rather than the sole reason to cross the river. The two businesses are distinct, so their different brewery connections provide a worthwhile comparison instead of an accidental duplicate.
